dex.entry: A great candlewood hound whose entire mane is a cathedral of living candles, radiating warm golden light that soothes nearby kin. An apex hound made of living light — the kind of kin you want walking beside you in the dark.

art.silhouette: Large, dignified canine silhouette; back and mane bristle with tall tapers in cream, gold, and amber; pooling light halos the outline; dramatic yet soft at 64px.
